result.reason: The redline largely reaches the preferred cap, mutuality, consequential-damages exclusion, and most required carve-outs, but it omits uncapped liability for breaches of data protection and security obligations. Section 8 cannot be assumed to supply those carve-outs. It also unnecessarily changes the fee lookback trigger from the filing/claim date to the event giving rise to liability, which may materially alter the cap calculation. The payment-fee exception is functionally close to the required treatment, though stating that payment obligations are not damages would be clearer. The drafting is otherwise targeted and generally preserves the original commercial structure; the margin comment does not cure the operative omissions.
